crossRefs.note: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

“ ‘ “But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them…
He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and…
But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look…

translations.web: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
translations.bsb: So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.
translations.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
translations.asv: and the commandment, which was unto life, this I found to be unto death:
